description: Calculates the area of geometric shapes including circle (πr²), triangle (½×base×height), rectangle (length×width), and square (side²). Returns area in square units. (cost: 1 credit)

measurements.description: object, required, shape-specific measurements (radius/base/height/length/width/side), appropriate units, no default

shape.description: string, required, shape type (circle/triangle/rectangle/square), no unit, no default

name: calculate_area
